consumer_contract.active_exit: 0xCE7A6 exits ready immediately when either inhibit is one
consumer_contract.normal_clear_case: both flags zero neither block entry nor force exit when other predicates pass
consumer_contract.ready_entry: 0xCE772 returns ready only when both inhibits are zero and its other predicates pass

openpilot_mapping.semantics: current steering unavailability, not a guarantee of automatic repair; no host-side persistence timer or new engagement policy
openpilot_mapping.steerFaultPermanent: not inferred from these lossy projections
openpilot_mapping.steerFaultTemporary: current selected hardware fault OR cooperative command inhibit OR cooperative angle inhibit

recovery_information_loss.boundary: these transmitted bits cannot independently select restart-required versus self-clearing causes; other diagnostic/status surfaces are not ruled out
recovery_information_loss.rate_latch: 0xCEF26 retains asserted FEBECAFD even in inactive profile bank 7
recovery_information_loss.request_failure: 0xCEE7C clears FEBECAFB in inactive profile bank 7
recovery_information_loss.subsystem_initialization: 0xCEC0C clears both sources and their combined flag
recovery_information_loss.wire_collision: CAFB=1/CAFD=0 and CAFB=0/CAFD=1 both publish the same command-inhibit bit

verification.boundary: scalar packer/status-submit callbacks are substituted; no CAN hardware or vehicle is exercised
verification.method: stock OR, RTE, readiness and recovery instructions; generated-COM argument capture at the packer boundary
